amtszeit.chronik.beginn_dauer: Term {nr} begins: a long rule has its price.
amtszeit.chronik.beginn_letzte: The last term: the president will not run again, the governing bloc needs a successor.
amtszeit.chronik.beginn_text: A reshuffle, new goals and a parliament after the election: the government gets a second chance.
amtszeit.log.letzte: This is the last term: the constitution allows no further candidacy; the governing bloc must put forward a successor.
amtszeit.log.warum: Within {tage} days the cabinet can be reshuffled at half cost; you choose the goals of the new term now.
amtszeit.log.ziele_warum: At the end the balance sheet measures what was achieved.
amtszeit.regel.chronik: The constitution allows the president to stand again.{hatName, select, ja { The choice of {name} as successor lapses.} other { The succession question is postponed.}}
amtszeit.regel.log: Succession is no longer needed: whoever holds the office may stand again.
bilanz.ende.abwahl: Why it ended: the majority wanted a different course.{hatKosten, select, ja { What cost the most: {kosten, list}.} other {}}
bilanz.ende.amtsenthebung: Why it ended: in the procedure {gegen} members of parliament stood against the president; the Constitutional Court gave the verdict.
bilanz.ende.amtszeitende: Why it ended: the constitution allows no further term.
bilanz.ende.putsch: Why it ended: the coup risk rose over months; in the end the largest contributions came from: {ursachen, list}.
bilanz.ende.ruecktritt: Why it ended: the president resigned.{hatKosten, select, ja { What cost the most: {kosten, list}.} other {}}
bilanz.ende.sturz: Why it ended: for months approval stayed below the threshold, and in the end the street carried the fall.{hatKosten, select, ja { What cost the most: {kosten, list}.} other {}}
bilanz.ende.tod: The president died in office. The balance sheet draws the line under the term.
bilanz.kriege: Wars and conflicts: {n, plural, one {one conflict} other {# conflicts}} ({liste, list}).
bilanz.nachfolge.niederlage: The governing bloc loses the succession election with {name}: the legacy is put to the test.
bilanz.nachfolge.sieg: The governing bloc wins the succession election with {name}: power is handed over in an orderly way.
bilanz.reich: The realm: {fertig, plural, one {one project stands} other {# projects stand}} at the end.
bilanz.ui.kicker: A chapter of the history books · {datum, date}
bilanz.ui.nichts: Nothing that would have demanded an answer.
bilanz.verfassung: Constitution: {n, plural, one {one article} other {# articles}} changed: {artikel, list}.
bilanz.wahl.gewonnen: Election on {datum, date}: {anteil, number, 1} percent {gang, select, stich {in the runoff} other {in the first round}}, a lead of {marge, number, 1} points. The governing bloc then held {sitze} seats (before: {vorher}).
bilanz.wahl.verloren: Election on {datum, date}: {anteil, number, 1} percent {gang, select, stich {in the runoff} other {in the first round}}; the election was lost. The governing bloc then held {sitze} seats (before: {vorher}).
bilanz.zusagen: Pledges: {gehalten} kept, {gebrochen} broken, {offen} open. Credibility ends at {glaub} out of 100.
bilanz.zustimmung: {hatHilfe, select, ja {What helped approval most: {hilfe, list}.} other {}}{hatKosten, select, ja { What cost it most: {kosten, list}.} other {}} At the end it stands at {jetzt} percent.
bilanz.zwischen.titel: Interim balance of the first term
nachfolge.chronik_text: {name} ({rolle}) is put forward as successor.{hatRivale, select, ja { {rivale} runs as a rival.} other {}}
nachfolge.ereignis.kuer_beschr: Costs {pk} capital; appeal {staerke}, ambition {ehrgeiz}. Those passed over grow resentful.
nachfolge.ereignis.offen_beschr: Costs nothing; the party chooses by strength, and those passed over feel less snubbed.
nachfolge.ereignis.spaeter_ausgang: You leave the succession question open.
nachfolge.ereignis.spaeter_beschr: Costs nothing; the question stays open and unrest grows.
nachfolge.ereignis.text1: You will not run again. The party expects a word from you on the succession, and in the cabinet the elbows are sharpening.
nachfolge.ereignis.text2_leer: There is nobody in the cabinet who could carry the succession.
nachfolge.ereignis.warum: The chosen successor gains support, those passed over lose it; anyone too ambitious may run as a rival against the governing bloc.
nachfolge.fehler: A succession election only exists in the last term.
nachfolge.log.offen: The party decides: {rolle} {name} becomes the successor.
nachfolge.log.rivale: {name} feels passed over and considers running independently.
nachfolge.ok_rivale: {name} is put forward as successor; {rivale} feels passed over and runs against the governing bloc.
nachfolge.schon: The successor has already been chosen.
umbildung.erinnerung.bestaetigt: Confirmed in office after the election
umbildung.erinnerung.partner: Brought into the cabinet as a minister of the {partei}
umbildung.erinnerung.versetzt: Moved to another portfolio after the election
umbildung.log.abgeschlossen_warum: Open claims of the partners become commitments; appointments are back at full price.
umbildung.log.behalten_warum: A confirmation costs nothing and strengthens loyalty.
umbildung.log.partner: {alt} makes way: a member of the {partei}, {neu}, takes over the ministry.
umbildung.log.partner_warum: The partner party counts the ministry towards its claim.
umbildung.log.versetzt_warum: In the unfamiliar portfolio both work at reduced capacity for two months.
umbildung.ui.einleitung: The voters have decided, now you order your cabinet. The constitution gives you a free hand: you appoint and dismiss ministers without parliament. For the next {tage} days every change costs {rabatt, number} percent less; after that the full price applies again.
umbildung.ui.fuss: {n} of {von} portfolios decided. Capital: {kapital}. Anyone not decided on stays in office.
umbildung.ui.kronprinzen: The succession question: these are your contenders
umbildung.ui.partner_anspruch: {partei} ({sitze} seats) expects {anspruch, plural, one {# ministry} other {# ministries}}, awarded: {vergeben}
umbildung.ui.zwischenbilanz: Interim balance of the first term
umbildung.zusage: The {partei} expects {n, plural, one {one more ministry} other {# more ministries}}
wahl.chronik.stichwahl_text: No absolute majority in the first round: {amt, number, 1} percent against {gegner, number, 1} percent for {gegnerName}. The runoff decides.
wahl.chronik.wiederwahl_text: {name} is re-elected {gang} with {anteil, number, 1} percent (a lead of {marge, number, 1} percentage points).
wahl.ende.abwahl: In the election on {datum, date}, {name} receives only {anteil, number, 1} percent {gang}; {gegner} wins.
wahl.ende.nachfolger_niederlage: After two terms the governing bloc loses the election: {name} receives only {anteil, number, 1} percent, {gegner} wins the office.
wahl.ende.nachfolger_niederlage_titel: The governing bloc loses the succession election
wahl.ende.nachfolger_sieg: The last term ends with a victory for the governing bloc: {name} becomes successor with {anteil, number, 1} percent (a lead of {marge, number, 1} points); power is handed over in an orderly way.
wahl.ende.nachfolger_sieg_titel: The governing bloc wins the succession election
wahl.ereignis.anfechtung.neu_ausgang: The recount confirms the result; the Electoral Board rejects the challenge.
wahl.ereignis.anfechtung.standard: The Electoral Board rejects the challenge; without your answer a shadow remains over the win.
wahl.ereignis.anfechtung.text1: The result is close: a lead of only {marge, number, 1} percentage points. {gegner} demands a recount.
wahl.ereignis.anfechtung.text2: The High Electoral Board decides finally; there is no appeal against its decisions.
wahl.ereignis.anfechtung.verteidigen_aus: You defend the result; the Electoral Board rejects the challenge, but the mistrust remains.
wahl.ereignis.anfechtung.warum: A narrow win is vulnerable. Showing transparency earns legitimacy; merely defending the result hardens the fronts.
wahl.ereignis.koalition.ausgang: The {partei} joins the governing bloc (+{sitze} seats).
wahl.ereignis.koalition.minderheit: Carry on as a minority government
wahl.ereignis.koalition.minderheit_ausga: The governing bloc carries on governing without a fixed majority.
wahl.ereignis.koalition.minderheit_besch: Costs nothing; every law needs case-by-case agreements.
wahl.ereignis.koalition.standard: Without a decision the formation of the government drags on.
wahl.ereignis.koalition.text1: After the parliamentary election your bloc has {sitze} seats; a majority needs 301.
wahl.ereignis.koalition.text2: Every party you bring on board has a price: it expects its core demand to be met, and ministries. Without a majority every law stays laborious.
wahl.ereignis.koalition.vertagen_beschr: Costs nothing; the partners use the time.
wahl.ereignis.koalition.warum: A president without a majority can govern but cannot shape: laws, the budget and constitutional changes need votes in parliament.
wahl.ereignis.stichwahl.abwarten_beschr: Costs nothing; the runoff follows the first round.
wahl.ereignis.stichwahl.mobil_beschr: Costs {pk} capital; more of your own voters turn out, and polarisation rises.
wahl.ereignis.stichwahl.text1: In the first round nobody reaches an absolute majority: you are at {amt, number, 1} percent, your opponent at {gegner, number, 1} percent, the third candidate at {dritte, number, 1} percent. The runoff decides.
wahl.ereignis.stichwahl.text2: The voters of {name} hold the balance: as things stand about {uebertrag, number} percent of them switch to you, the rest stay at home or vote for your opponent.
wahl.ereignis.stichwahl.titel: Runoff: two weeks to the decision
wahl.ereignis.stichwahl.warum: The runoff is a two-week campaign of its own: courting the eliminated gains votes, mobilising your own people gains turnout, and both have a price.
wahl.ereignis.stichwahl.werben_beschr: Costs {pk} capital; a larger share of his voters vote for you in the runoff.
wahl.hinweis.stichwahl_text: Nobody reaches an absolute majority. {amtName} stands at {amt, number, 1} percent, {gegnerName} at {gegner, number, 1} percent. The runoff decides in {tage} days; the parliamentary election is already over.
wahl.hinweis.wiederwahl_text: {name} wins the presidential election with {anteil, number, 1} percent. Term {nr} begins{letzte, select, ja {; it is the last} other {}}. The governing bloc holds {sitze} seats in the new parliament.
wahl.log.stichwahl_noetig: First round without an absolute majority: {amt, number, 1} to {gegner, number, 1} percent.
wahl.log.stichwahl_warum: The runoff decides in {tage} days; until then every vote of the eliminated candidates counts.
wahl.log.wiederwahl: Election night: {name} is confirmed in office {gang} with {anteil, number, 1} percent.
wahl.log.wiederwahl_warum: A new term begins; after the parliamentary election the governing bloc holds {sitze} seats.
wahl.nachtrag.chronik_text: The parliamentary election of {datum, date} is evaluated retroactively: the bloc has {nachher} seats, before it was {vorher} ({richtung, select, plus {+} other {−}}{diff}).
wahl.nachtrag.frage.heute: Today your bloc holds {sitze} of 600 seats.
wahl.nachtrag.frage.ja_beschr: Seats, bloc and coalitions are determined anew under the rules of the election, with the mood around election day. That can cost or win majorities.
wahl.nachtrag.frage.nein_beschr: Everything stays as it is. The game will not ask again.
wahl.nachtrag.frage.sicherung: The current save is kept as a backup (title screen, “Earlier backups”).
wahl.nachtrag.frage.text: The parliamentary election of {datum, date} was played with an older version of the game, without a new distribution of seats. Evaluate it retroactively?
wahl.nachtrag.hinweis_text: The parliamentary election of {datum, date} has been evaluated retroactively: the bloc holds {nachher} seats (before: {vorher}).
wahl.nachtrag.ja_ausgang: The seats are redistributed: the bloc holds {nachher} seats.
wahl.nachtrag.keine_frage: There is no open question about the parliamentary election.
wahl.nachtrag.log_frage: The parliamentary election was played without a new distribution of seats.
wahl.nachtrag.log_frage_warum: The election of {datum, date} was played with an older version of the game; the game asks whether to evaluate it retroactively.
wahl.nachtrag.log_ja: The parliamentary election of {datum, date} is carried out retroactively.
wahl.nachtrag.log_ja_warum: After the election the bloc holds {nachher} seats (before: {vorher}); the mood around election day determines the shift.
wahl.nachtrag.log_nein_warum: The parliamentary election is not carried out retroactively; the game will not ask again.
wahl.nachtrag.zeitung_fakt: The parliamentary election of {datum, date} has been evaluated retroactively: the governing bloc has {nachher} seats{mehrheit, select, ja { and therefore a majority} other { and therefore no majority}}.
wahl.reaktion.ausland_gegner: Abroad, attention turns to {name} and waits for the first signals from the new president.
wahl.reaktion.beobachter_fair: Election observers call the vote largely orderly and fair; the High Electoral Board decides finally, there is no appeal.
wahl.reaktion.beobachter_kritik: Election observers criticise restrictions on the press and the judiciary beforehand; the High Electoral Board decides finally, there is no appeal.
wahl.reaktion.eu_mahnt: The European Union calls for respect for the rule of law and press freedom.
wahl.reaktion.lager_mehrheit: The governing bloc holds {sitze} seats in the new parliament ({richtung, select, plus {+{diff}} other {−{diff}}} compared with before) and therefore a majority.
wahl.reaktion.lager_ohne_mehrheit: The governing bloc holds {sitze} seats in the new parliament ({richtung, select, plus {+{diff}} other {−{diff}}} compared with before); {fehlt} seats short of a majority.
wahl.reaktion.maerkte_nervoes: Markets react nervously to a narrow or unclear result.
wahl.reaktion.maerkte_ruhig: Markets react calmly: a clear result takes uncertainty out of prices.
wahl.reaktion.nachtrag_opposition: After the election the {partei} holds {sitze} seats and leads the opposition.
wahl.reaktion.opp_anerkennt: {name} ({partei}) concedes defeat and announces that the opposition will carry on in parliament.
wahl.reaktion.opp_anfechtung: {name} ({partei}) does not accept the result: with a margin of only {marge, number, 1} points the opposition wants to contest the count.
wahl.reaktion.opp_siegt: {name} ({partei}) celebrates the election victory and takes over the office.
wahl.rede.bescheiden_ausgang: You give thanks, call for work and keep the speech short: a little trust, a little legitimacy.
wahl.rede.einend_ausgang: You reach out to the losers and speak for the whole country: the trenches grow a little shallower, the nationalists grumble.
wahl.rede.keine: A speech is only given after an election victory.
wahl.rede.schon: The speech has already been given.
wahl.rede.triumph_ausgang: You celebrate the victory before cheering supporters: the base is thrilled, the divisions in the country deepen.
wahl.schuld.log: The promise debt is called in.
wahl.schuld.titel: The promise debt is called in
wahl.stichwahl.abwarten_ausgang: You let the campaign run its course; the runoff follows the balance of power from the first round.
wahl.stichwahl.mobil_ausgang: You mobilise your own supporters: more of them will turn out in the runoff, and the fronts harden.
wahl.stichwahl.werben_ausgang: You court the third candidate's voters: a larger share of them will vote for you in the runoff.
wahl.stichwahl.werben_ausgang_zusage: You court the third candidate's voters: the {partei} endorses you but expects {forderung} after the election; a larger share of its voters back you.
wahl.stichwahl.zusage: The {partei} expects {forderung} in return for its endorsement
wahl.ui.fuss_ende: The election is lost; the balance of your term follows.
wahl.ui.fuss_letzte: The governing bloc has won; your term ends with the handover.
wahl.ui.fuss_nachgetragen: Next come the reshuffle and the goals of the term.
wahl.ui.fuss_weiter: Next you reorder the cabinet and choose the goals of the new term.
wahl.ui.karte_aria: Map of the provinces coloured by winner
wahl.ui.lager_fehlt: The governing bloc is {fehlen} seats short of a majority.
wahl.ui.lager_mehrheit: The governing bloc holds {sitze} of 600 seats and therefore a majority.
wahl.ui.nachtrag_text: The president was confirmed in office back then; this shows only the parliamentary election that had been left out in the older version of the game.
wahl.ui.niederlage: {name} wins with {anteil, number, 1} percent; you lose the election.
wahl.ui.niederlage_nachfolger: {name} wins with {anteil, number, 1} percent; the governing bloc loses the succession election.
wahl.ui.rede.bescheiden_beschr: Gives thanks and calls for work: a little trust, a little legitimacy.
wahl.ui.rede.einend_beschr: Extends a hand: less polarisation, more legitimacy, but the nationalists grumble.
wahl.ui.rede.triumph_beschr: Celebrates the win: the base cheers, polarisation rises.
wahl.ui.schwelle: The line marks 50 percent: whoever has more wins in the first round, otherwise the runoff decides.
wahl.ui.sieg: {name} wins with {anteil, number, 1} percent, {marge, number, 1} points ahead of the runner-up.
wahl.ui.sieg_nachfolger: The successor {name} wins with {anteil, number, 1} percent, {marge, number, 1} points ahead of the runner-up.
wahl.ui.titel_letzte: Election night: the successor is elected
wahl.ui.unter_huerde: Failed to clear the threshold: {parteien, list}.
wahl.zeitung.fakt: {name} wins the presidential election with {anteil, number, 1} percent of the vote.
ziel.amtszeit.text: Choose up to three goals for the new term. Goals that are already met are no longer offered. At the end the balance sheet measures both terms.
ziel.amtszeit.titel: What should remain of this term?
ziel.ansehen60.beschreibung: Turkey's standing is at 60 or more at the end.
ziel.frieden.beschreibung: At the end of the term Turkey is at war with no country.
ziel.frieden.stand_krieg: {n, plural, one {one ongoing war} other {# ongoing wars}}
ziel.kabinett.beschreibung: No member of the government has a loyalty below 30 at the end.
ziel.kabinett.stand_schwach: {n, plural, one {one member below 30} other {# members below 30}}
ziel.nachfolge.beschreibung: The governing bloc wins the election of the last term with the successor you put forward.
ziel.ordnung.beschreibung: The terror threat is at 35 or less and crime at 45 or less at the end.
ziel.partner5.beschreibung: At the end of the term at least five countries trust Turkey (trust of 55 or more).
ziel.partner5.stand: {n} countries with trust of 55 or more
ziel.rechtsstaat60.beschreibung: The independence of the judiciary is at 60 or more at the end.
ziel.vertraege3.beschreibung: At the end of the term at least three agreements with other countries are in force.
ziel.wort.beschreibung: Credibility, measured by promises kept and broken, is at 70 or more at the end.
ziel.start.titel: What should remain of this term?
ziel.start.text: Choose up to three goals. They are your benchmark: The nation, your partners, and the history books will measure your presidency by them. Goals are measurable and cannot all be attained at once.
ziel.ui.beginnen_mit: Begin with {n, plural, one {1 goal} other {# goals}}
ziel.inflation15.beschreibung: Published inflation drops below 15% by the end of the presidential term.
ziel.arbeit8.beschreibung: The unemployment rate falls below 8% by term end.
ziel.schulden30.beschreibung: Sovereign public debt remains below 30% of GDP.
ziel.wasserstrom.beschreibung: No province suffers from acute water shortages or power grid blackouts.
ziel.erdbeben.beschreibung: Acute seismic vulnerability is reduced to at most 5 provinces.
ziel.wohnen.beschreibung: Acute housing shortage is eliminated across all 81 provinces.
ziel.aerzte.beschreibung: No province suffers from acute specialist doctor deficits.
ziel.strassen.beschreibung: The highway and transport network in every province reaches at least level 45.
ziel.mehrheit.beschreibung: The governing coalition maintains at least 301 seats at term end.
ziel.vertrauen60.beschreibung: Average public confidence in the administration rises to at least 60.
